entities.summary: St Peter's Italian Church is a Roman Catholic basilica-style church located in Saffron Hill on Clerkenwell Road, Holborn, London. It lies just within the boundaries of the London Borough of Camden, but is particularly associated with the Italian community of Clerkenwell, whose hub lies within the London Borough of Islington. St Peter's Italian Church is a Catholic church building in Europe, established in 1863-04-16. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
